info.name: Housing & Roommate Management Platform API
info.description:
REST API collection for the Housing & Roommate Management Platform.
Roles: TENANT / OWNER / ADMIN (+ SUPER_ADMIN).
Demo login: admin@housing.com / Admin@1234, owner@housing.com / Owner@1234, tenant@housing.com / Tenant@1234.

body.raw:
{
    "contactNumber": "01712345678",
    "occupation": "Product Designer",
    "preferredCity": "Dhaka",
    "monthlyBudgetMax": 25000,
    "smoker": false,
    "petFriendly": true,
    "lookingForRoommate": true,
    "bio": "Friendly, tidy professional looking for a shared flat."
}

request.description: Field 'document' (image or PDF, 8MB limit). Resets verification to PENDING; an admin then approves/rejects (Admin > Review Tenant Verification).

request.description: OWNER only. Target must be an ACTIVE PROPERTY_MANAGER user; duplicate assignment -> 409. Manager is notified.
OWNER or an assigned manager of this property.
OWNER only (managerId = ManagerProfile id). Manager is notified; revocation takes effect immediately.
Lease holder invites a VERIFIED tenant to share their leased room (max 1 ACTIVE member per lease). Invitee must be an active TENANT account.
Both sides (holder + invited member); rows carry computed role HOLDER|MEMBER.
action: ACCEPT | DECLINE (invitee only).
Holder or member ends an ACTIVE membership.
Holder / property owner / assigned manager / admin.
ACTIVE member or holder; trimmed lease-scoped projection (no payment data).

gateway: bkash (default) | sslcommerz | stripe. Only VERIFIED tenants may pay. Returns { payment, paymentUrl } - the browser redirect for whichever gateway was chosen (bKash bkashURL / SSLCommerz GatewayPageURL / Stripe Checkout URL).
gateway: bkash (default) | sslcommerz | stripe. Response { payment, paymentUrl } per gateway; duplicate live sessions -> 409.

Hit by the SSLCommerz sandbox after the payer finishes (success/fail/cancel POST). Only a validator-verified val_id (VALID/VALIDATED) ever settles; forged values are parked FAILED. Simulate locally with the query params: paymentId = applicationId/invoiceId, tranId = providerPaymentId stored on the Payment row.
Instant Payment Notification (server-to-server, JSON 200 ack). Same validation as /confirm; idempotent on replays.

Raw-body route mounted BEFORE the JSON parsers (signature verification needs exact bytes). For real testing use the Stripe CLI: 'stripe listen --forward-to localhost:5000/api/v1/payment/webhook/stripe' and trigger checkout.session.completed. Only allowlisted events (completed with payment_status=paid -> settle; expired while PROCESSING -> cancel) change state; replays are no-ops; amount_total (minor units) is verified against the initiation snapshot.
Properties the manager is assigned to (membership-based delegation scope).
outcome: REFUNDED | NOT_REFUNDED (restores PAID so the tenant can retry the termination).
PROCESSING payments whose provider notification was lost (money possibly captured, nothing settled) - the success-side counterpart of the refund queue.
outcome: SETTLED (runs the same guarded settle path - lease/bed/invoice side effects) | NOT_SETTLED (downgrades to FAILED so the tenant can retry). Double-resolve -> 409.
verificationStatus: APPROVED | REJECTED (rejectionReason required when rejecting). Only VERIFIED tenants may start payment sessions.
PROPERTY_MANAGER only; non-monetary metrics scoped to assigned properties.
